explanation: The widened membershipRule is right in reach, but two things are short. (1) The rule says CMTX files are saved under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Policy Plus; PolicyLoader.GetCmtxPath (151-160) puts them there only for a registry source. For POL and NTUSER.DAT sources the CMTX sits beside the file (ChangeExtension to cmtx), and for local and SID GPOs it is comment.cmtx in the Registry.pol folder. State all three. (2) The evidence cites CmtxFile.vb 83-91 (building the XML) but not the XmlDocument Load (CmtxFile.vb 12) or Save (122), and omits other file calls the rule names: CMTX save at Main.vb 618, POL import and export by dialog at Main.vb 727 and 748, REG import and export (ImportReg.vb 16-38, ExportReg.vb 29), and the ADMX folder probes at OpenAdmxFolder.vb 23-35. Add these lines so every way named in the rule has its evidence.
